title: bug: governance ledger reads pre-#52 decision rows as unreadable, so AI governance never decides again on UnAI and the wrapper logs it as "no answer could be produced"
description:
Filed by governor-cc0cc843 2026-09-18 from live measurement of the UnAI project (the owner's live build), all READ-ONLY. The governance seat (PR #51 d2be4f09, PR #52 65f73a0c; owner direction 09-16: "make it take the best decision without me") is fully disabled on UnAI, and the log hides why.

MEASURED
1. UnAI store (D:/projexts/UnAI/store.sqlite, read with node:sqlite {readOnly:true}) holds 5 GovernanceDecisionRecorded rows, all in ONE aggregate governance-decision/823232837a8c...: positions 4994, 5031, 5032 (2026-09-16, written before #52) have 12 keys and NO `findingSubject`; 5271, 5310 (2026-09-17 21:11Z / 21:22Z, node:v1:257b0697) have 13 keys incl. findingSubject.
2. Replaying origin/main's recordOf checks (governance-decision-ledger.ts ~:185 exact key-set == RECORD_KEYS, ~:186 version == "moe-governance-decision/1") over those payloads: 4994/5031/5032 UNREADABLE (missing=findingSubject), 5271/5310 READABLE. The dist/moe-windows artifact's decider + governor-seat are byte-identical to origin/main.
3. read() (~:196-213) returns null on the FIRST unreadable row ("An unreadable row is not skipped past"), so fundedOn() is null for EVERY node on this project, so decideGovernanceEscalation returns HUMAN_NEEDED LEDGER_UNREADABLE (decider ~:228) BEFORE the advisor is asked.
4. wrapper-governance-pass.ts ~:89-95 maps every HUMAN_NEEDED `why` except BOUND_SPENT/ROUND_CEILING to "no answer could be produced". So a store-read failure is reported to the owner as a model that could not answer.
5. Live corroboration: UnAI wrapper.log has 302 "[governance] node:v1:257b0697...: no answer could be produced; it needs your decision in the control room" lines (270 during one 72-min wait). A 150-s sample of wrapper pid 48836's children: 10 such lines, ZERO claude/codex/cmd spawns (one git.exe only). The advisor (governor-seat.ts, `MOE_AGENT_COMMAND ?? "claude"` via execFile) is never invoked. No GovernanceDecisionRecorded since 2026-09-17T21:22:28Z.
6. Consequence for node:v1:257b0697 (store): review rounds 11 (05:07:20Z) and 13 (06:33:43Z) both routed ESCALATE (review-findings.ts: past REVIEW_ESCALATION_ROUND_LIMIT=3 only a CLEAN round avoids ESCALATE, and the seats self-reported one MINOR finding each). The human had to issue escalation.decide ALLOW_MORE_ATTEMPTS at 06:19:41Z (unsuccessfulRounds 6), and it is parked on the owner again now. Governance is the designed release valve for exactly this and it is dead.

NOT MEASURED: how 5271/5310 were written at 21:11Z/21:22Z while the 09-16 rows were present (likely an artifact whose reader pre-dated #52's key; the 21:44Z / 04:55Z re-packs made the reader strict). Irrelevant to the fix, relevant to the regression story.

DIRECTION (architect decides): a KNOWN legacy shape is not corruption. Decode/upcast pre-#52 rows (versioned, e.g. findingSubject derived or explicitly legacy) while genuinely malformed rows still fail closed. Also worth a census of other exact-key-set durable readers whose RECORD_KEYS widened without a legacy path (not required). Optional: log an unchanged (node, reviewVersion, why) HUMAN_NEEDED once, not every ~15 s.

SAFETY: never write to D:/projexts/UnAI/store.sqlite. Live proof runs against a COPY (store.sqlite + -wal + -shm) in a scratch dir.
definitionOfDone: A real-store arm seeded with the EXACT pre-#52 12-key row shape (no findingSubject, version moe-governance-decision/1) plus a current 13-key row: fundedOn returns the correct number, not null, and the legacy decision stays readable with a stated findingSubject treatment. A genuinely malformed row (unknown key or unparsable JSON) still makes the read fail closed (null), asserted with its own arm. Pre-fix RED recorded for the legacy arm.

The wrapper governance log names the real reason for every HUMAN_NEEDED `why`: LEDGER_UNREADABLE and NO_ANSWER produce distinct lines. Arms assert the exact string per `why` (global rail: assert the code, not just the outcome).

Live proof against a COPY of D:/projexts/UnAI/store.sqlite (+ -wal/-shm): with the fixed reader, fundedOn('node:v1:257b06976be8cdd9e1d89aaaa116eda38b00ce3f149c280b50a806c2099e7865') returns a number, and decideGovernanceEscalation no longer returns LEDGER_UNREADABLE for it. Output quoted verbatim. The live store is never written.
Daemon review + orchestrator suites and `pnpm typecheck` green, with no new reds versus the pre-fix baseline (timeout flakes re-run alone and named).
